correctness.rationale: Exact derivative numerator factors as -2xQ_s(x^2) over a positive denominator. Q_s is strictly convex on y>=0 and its unconstrained minimum has exact sign 9r^4(r^2-1), classifying all heights. Exact threshold factorization supplies multiplicities; the local derivatives -2sqrt(2) and -18sqrt(2) yield the positive 16/9 unnormalized contrast coefficient. Sparse-polynomial certificate and finite regime spot checks reproduce critical identities. The continuum proof is analytic and all boundary cases are addressed.

value.rationale: The three-atom symmetric Poisson extension is a canonical minimal nontrivial resolution test for positive harmonic kernels, directly motivated by the recent sharp three-source tangential critical bound. The theorem gives the exact all-height peak number, boundary multiplicity, resolvability threshold and nontrivial sharp 3/2 peak-contrast law; these quantitative invariants are not implied by zero-count bounds and measure loss of modal separation.
